english.note: For saying how a word or phrase is articulated, this is the all-purpose choice.
Use 發音 when talking about how a letter, word, or syllable is pronounced.

examples.english: I still don't know how to pronounce this English word.
examples.traditional: 我仲係唔識發音呢個英文生字。
